You only need to threaten to do something to make him cave.|An Imperial spacer and [[Imperial officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]]|<ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Empire!"}}</ref>}}
A '''family''' existed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Wolff Kalos]], his sister [[Mirrian]] and their parents were members of the family. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an agent of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] threatened the family to force Wolff Kalos to reveal secret information about a wanted [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name [[Cal Handro]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wolff Kalos's family was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wolff Kalos's family was mentioned during the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline,<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]", on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
